resources.name: Quantum ESPRESSO or other open-source plane-wave DFT code

access.notes: Any open-source DFT code supporting PBE and harmonic frequency calculations may be used.
The slab models are built from the fcc Ir bulk structure; the agent may also perform a PBE bulk optimization to obtain the lattice constant.

resources.name: Pseudopotentials for Ir, N, and O

access.package: typically included with Quantum ESPRESSO (e.g., Ir.pbe-...UPF, N.pbe-...UPF, O.pbe-...UPF)
access.notes: Standard PBE pseudopotentials (ultrasoft or PAW) from public libraries are required.
